subject: Cloudlane onboarding: DPA, SOC2 link & PO routing
messages:
From: Elise Tan <elise@cloudlane.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding kickoff + billing/PO questions

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this — Cloudlane is excited to move forward with Redwood for inference. We have an SOW coming but procurement asked me to get the vendor onboarding packet, data protection terms (DPA), SOC 2 link, and subprocessor list so they can start the PO and security review.

Couple of quick asks so we can parallelize:
- Can you confirm the billing contact and invoicing email for PO issuance?
- Do you have a DocuSign or portal link for the DPA we can sign?
- Is your SOC 2 report accessible via a link (not just PDF) and does it include last 12 months?
- Any preferred filename or reference we should use when we send over our procurement forms?

I attached our vendor intake form and a short redline tracker we use for legal (see Cloudlane_Onboarding_Package.zip). Would like to have a PO reference in place before the SOW is countersigned.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if that speeds things up.

—Elise
Elise Tan
Head of Finance Operations, Cloudlane
elise@cloudlane.io | +1 415-555-0143

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elise Tan <elise@cloudlane.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff + billing/PO questions

Hi Elise — great to meet you (virtually). Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Billing / PO routing
- Invoices should be sent to billing@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject line and invoice PDF attached.
- Billing contact for any questions: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com, +1 650-555-0210).

2) DPA / signing
- We use DocuSign for standard DPAs. Please review and sign via: https://app.docusign.com/CL-4782/dpa-sign
- If you prefer countersigning by PDF, reply with the signed file and we will countersign and return.

3) SOC 2 and subprocessor info
- SOC 2 summary (read-only): https://reports.cloudlane.io/soc2/2028/summary
- Full compliance pack (SOC 2 attestation + control matrix) can be shared through our secure vendor portal once you submit the onboarding form.
- Current subprocessor list (summary) is included in the portal. If you need the full roster for procurement review I can export a CSV.

4) Intake / PO reference
- No special filename required — please include your internal Cloudlane PO number in the subject when you submit invoices.

Next steps for fastest path to activation:
- Elise: sign the DPA on DocuSign (link above) or send signed PDF.
- Cloudlane: fill the vendor portal intake after signing so we can provision billing and SSO if needed: https://portal.redwood.com/vendor/onboard/CL-4782
- Marissa (cc'd) will confirm invoice routing and issue a PO template if you need one.

Attachments I will upload to the portal after you confirm: our standard DPA template (Redwood_DPA_2028_v2.pdf) and a one-page guide on PO fields.

If helpful, Vanessa (ops) is cc'd and can join the handoff call. I can do 10–11am PT today if that works.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Elise Tan <elise@cloudlane.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff + billing/PO questions

Thanks Rishi — that helps. I signed the DPA and uploaded a signed copy to this thread (Cloudlane_Signed_DPA.pdf).

A couple of follow-ups from procurement after quick review:
- They asked for a short exported list of subprocessors that handle customer data (names + purpose). Can you provide that as a CSV or spreadsheet?
- They also requested the evidence that the SOC 2 cover period includes the last 12 months — the portal summary link shows dates but procurement sometimes needs the attestation header. If you can either share the attestation header or confirm we can download the full report after intake, that would be great.

I attached our filled intake and a redline sheet in the package we sent earlier; you should see the same files in the zip.

Attachments: Cloudlane_Signed_DPA.pdf, Cloudlane_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Best,
Elise

Hi Elise — received, thanks for the signed DPA. Quick status and items I uploaded to the vendor portal this morning:

- I confirmed and uploaded the Redwood countersigned DPA (file stub: Redwood_Countersigned_DPA_2028.pdf) to the portal and to this thread for your records.
- Exported the current subprocessor roster as a spreadsheet (attached: Redwood_Subprocessors_2028.csv). That file lists each subprocessor name, processing purpose, and whether they handle customer content or metadata.
- For SOC 2: I uploaded the attestation header (Redwood_SOC2_Attestation_Header_2028.pdf) to the portal. Procurement should be able to download the full attestation after the intake is completed. If Cloudlane needs the full PDF ASAP, I can arrange secure transfer to account_ops@cloudlane.io.

PO routing recap (from Marissa):
- Please send the PO to billing@redwood.com and copy marissa@redwood.com. Invoices should reference the PO number and include a line item for the SOW when available.
- If you need an internal Redwood PO number before SOW, we can provision a placeholder PO (PO-RW-CL-2028-001) to reference on your side; Marissa will confirm once she sees your intake completed.

Next steps:
- Elise: confirm whether you want the full SOC 2 sent directly to account_ops@cloudlane.io or if procurement will pull it from the portal after intake.
- Marissa: will confirm placeholder PO number and invoice template.

Thanks — happy to stand up a 15m call if you want to walk procurement through the exported subprocessor CSV.

Best,
Rishi
